SELECT CASE WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='127f3854-4183-4354-a654-f59320d8807e' AND clan_hoki_private.routes_ability(p_actor,p_ability) THEN clan_hoki_private.needle_ability(p_actor,p_defense)
 WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='c8d32b00-3917-41a6-8906-388e7b9efcc7' AND clan_hoki_private.routes_ability(p_actor,p_ability) THEN NULL
 WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='3b4c4fd0-c0c2-46a0-a387-f47a95ef7dda'::uuid AND clan_akimichi_private.replacement_applies(p_actor) THEN NULL::jsonb
 WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='214af896-15f8-43e6-858b-614d2851dd3b'::uuid AND clan_akimichi_private.replacement_applies(p_actor) THEN
  CASE WHEN p_defense IS FALSE THEN (
   SELECT clan_akimichi_private.partial_meta(p_actor, a.value)
   FROM public.combat_v2_actors x
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.mechanics_snapshot->'abilities','[]'::jsonb)) a(value)
   WHERE x.id=p_actor AND a.value->>'source'='clan' AND a.value->>'id'=p_ability::text
   LIMIT 1
  ) ELSE NULL::jsonb END
 WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='db51e5ae-8b90-4c3a-a51d-962eb9e19b38'::uuid
   AND combat_panel_private.nara_routes_possession_v1(p_actor)
 THEN combat_panel_private.nara_offer_meta_v1(p_actor,p_defense)
 WHEN p_source='clan'AND p_ability='6cc40917-1719-4759-9ba8-3064b806c24e'::uuid
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors a WHERE a.id=p_actor AND a.mechanics_snapshot ? 'fenice_staff_dependency')THEN
 (SELECT proof->'ability'FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT clan_innata_narrative_private.fenice_staff_proof_v1(a.id)proof)q
 WHERE a.id=p_actor AND p_defense IS FALSE AND proof IS NOT NULL AND proof=a.mechanics_snapshot->'fenice_staff_dependency'
 AND(SELECT count(*)FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.mechanics_snapshot->'abilities')x WHERE x=proof->'ability')=1)
 ELSE(SELECT CASE WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability='58a2f5cd-6409-40f6-8f18-cfdb4410ca26'::uuid THEN
 CASE WHEN p_defense THEN clan_hyuga_private.rotation_ability_meta(p_actor) ELSE NULL END
 ELSE clan_aburame_private.actor_ability(p_actor,p_source,p_ability,p_defense,(select combat_v2_elemental_internal.scudo_ability_meta(p_actor,combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_ability_meta(p_actor,combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_ability_meta(p_actor,clan_uchiha_private.fireball_ability_meta(p_actor,clan_hyuga_private.sedici_ability_meta(p_actor,a.value)))))
  from public.combat_v2_actors x
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.mechanics_snapshot->'abilities','[]'::jsonb)) a(value)
  where x.id=p_actor and a.value->>'source'=p_source and (a.value->>'id')::uuid=p_ability
    and (not p_defense or coalesce((a.value->>'defensive')::boolean,false))
    and CASE WHEN p_source='clan' AND p_ability IN (
          '1260dbc8-ab0c-4b2b-9b94-909d39b7ffbe'::uuid,'5bf9764e-b719-4972-9d75-083b4cb633e7'::uuid)
        THEN clan_uchiha_private.fireball_ability_meta(p_actor,a.value) IS NOT NULL
        ELSE (not combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(p_ability)
         or combat_v2_elemental_internal.eligible_v1(x.character_id,p_ability,p_defense)
         or (p_defense AND p_source='clan' AND p_ability='9061c022-ca82-4d2b-8102-e208fcc6c1a2'::uuid AND combat_v2_elemental_internal.scudo_profile(p_actor) IS NOT NULL)
         or (NOT p_defense AND p_source='clan' AND coalesce(combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_profile(p_actor,p_ability),combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_profile(p_actor,p_ability)) IS NOT NULL)) END
    and clan_hyuga_private.sedici_ability_meta(p_actor,a.value) IS NOT NULL
    and clan_uchiha_private.fireball_ability_meta(p_actor,a.value) IS NOT NULL
  limit 1)) END)END

declare v_out jsonb;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'name',c.name,'vita',c.vita,'vita_max',c.vita_max,'chakra',c.chakra,'chakra_max',c.chakra_max,
    'taijutsu',c.taijutsu,'ninjutsu',c.ninjutsu,'kekkei_genkai',c.kekkei_genkai,'genjutsu',c.genjutsu,'forza',c.forza,
    'velocita',c.velocita,'mente',c.mente,'resistenza',c.resistenza,'fuuinjutsu',c.fuuinjutsu,'slancio',0,
    'abilities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'name') from (
      select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('source','clan','id',t.id,'name',t.name,'kind',coalesce(t.category,'fisico'),
        'usage',t.uso,'defensive',coalesce(t.difensiva,false),'di_scena',coalesce(t.di_scena,false),'diversivo',false,'consumption_type',coalesce(t.consumption_type,'ad_utilizzo'),'range',t.gittata,'chakra_cost',coalesce(t.chakra_cost,0),
        'damage_base',coalesce(t.danno_base,0),'element',case when cardinality(t.req_elements)>0 then t.req_elements[1] end,
        'element_requirements',case when combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(t.id) then to_jsonb(t.req_elements) end,
        'element_mode',case when combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(t.id) then t.req_elements_mode end,
        'element_authority',case when combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(t.id) then 'character_elementi/1' end,
        'targeting_mode',case when combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(t.id) then case when t.difensiva then 'self_defense' else 'single_enemy' end end)) x
      from public.character_abilities ca join public.clan_techniques t on t.id=ca.technique_id
      where ca.character_id=c.id and ca.state='attiva' and t.is_active
        and (not combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1(t.id) or combat_v2_elemental_internal.eligible_v1(c.id,t.id,null))
      union all
      select jsonb_build_object('source','jutsu','id',j.id,'name',j.name_it,'kind',coalesce(j.category,'fisico'),
        'usage',j.uso,'defensive',coalesce(j.difensiva,false),'di_scena',coalesce(j.di_scena,false),'diversivo',coalesce(j.diversivo,false),'consumption_type','ad_utilizzo','range',j.gittata,'chakra_cost',coalesce(j.chakra_cost,0),
        'damage_base',coalesce(j.damage_base,0),'element',j.nature) x
      from public.character_jutsu cj join public.jutsu j on j.id=cj.jutsu_id
      where cj.user_id=c.user_id and j.is_active
    ) q),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_out from public.characters c where c.id=p_character;
  v_out:=jsonb_set(v_out,'{abilities}',combat_v2_multitarget_internal.enrich_abilities_v1(v_out->'abilities'),false);
  return v_out;
end

declare v_uid uuid:=exam_regia_private.current_principal(); v_a public.combat_v2_actors%rowtype; v_r public.combat_v2_rounds%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_a from public.combat_v2_actors where id=p_actor;
  if v_a.companion_id is not null then perform public.combat_v2_fail('compagno_senza_turno','Comandi disponibili soltanto al controllore.',409,null,'{}'); end if;
  select * into v_r from public.combat_v2_rounds where id=p_round;
  if v_a.id is null or v_r.id is null or v_a.session_id<>v_r.session_id then perform public.combat_v2_fail('opzione_non_offerta','Attore o round non valido.',422,null,'{}'); end if;
  if exam_regia_private.actor_principal(v_a.id,v_a.controller_user)<>v_uid then perform public.combat_v2_fail('attore_non_controllato','Non controlli questo attore.',403,null,'{}'); end if;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_admissions_v1 adm WHERE adm.encounter_id=v_r.session_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw WHERE uw.round_id=p_round)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_TURN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw WHERE uw.round_id=p_round AND uw.publication_id IS NULL)
    AND NOT mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(p_round)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_windows_v1 hw
      JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms ON ms.id=hw.master_session_id
      WHERE hw.next_round_id=p_round AND hw.state='private'
       AND ms.master_user=auth.uid() AND public.master_v2_is_master(auth.uid()))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MUF_PUBLICATION_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exam_human_private.round_publication_windows_v1 w
      JOIN exam_human_private.requests e ON e.id=w.exam_id
      WHERE w.next_round_id=p_round AND w.state<>'published'
        AND (v_a.actor_kind<>'png' OR e.master_user IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGIA_FATO_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  return public.combat_v2_envelope(null,jsonb_build_object('round',p_round,'actor',p_actor,'phase',v_r.phase,
    'abilities',(
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(combat_v2_multitarget_internal.enrich_ability_v1(combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_ability_meta(p_actor,combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_ability_meta(p_actor,e.value))) order by e.ord),'[]'::jsonb)
      from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_a.mechanics_snapshot->'abilities','[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality e(value,ord)
      where e.value->>'id'<>'31b15861-fb78-4f8a-ac1c-ebf2d957c32e'
        and (not combat_v2_elemental_internal.is_target_v1((e.value->>'id')::uuid)
          or (v_r.phase='raccolta_azioni' and (combat_v2_elemental_internal.eligible_v1(v_a.character_id,(e.value->>'id')::uuid,false)
            or (e.value->>'source'='clan' and coalesce(combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_profile(p_actor,(e.value->>'id')::uuid),combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_profile(p_actor,(e.value->>'id')::uuid)) IS NOT NULL)))
          or (v_r.phase='raccolta_difese' and combat_v2_elemental_internal.eligible_v1(v_a.character_id,(e.value->>'id')::uuid,true)))
        and not (v_r.phase='raccolta_difese' and e.value->>'id'='9f12fc98-bc97-4b95-9bcc-7ce359ebbe4f' and not exists (
          select 1 from public.combat_v2_attack_targets mt join public.combat_v2_declarations ad on ad.id=mt.attack_declaration_id
          where mt.round_id=p_round and mt.target_actor_id=p_actor and mt.state='attesa_difesa' and not combat_panel_private.multiplication_no_defense(mt.id)
            and lower(coalesce(ad.sanitized_intent#>>'{server_ability,kind}','')) like '%genjutsu%'))
    ),
    'targeting_contract','combat-targeting/1.1','pending_attack_targets',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('attack_target_id',t.id,'attack_declaration_id',t.attack_declaration_id,'target_actor_id',t.target_actor_id)order by t.created_at,t.ordinal),'[]'::jsonb)from public.combat_v2_attack_targets t join public.combat_v2_actors x on x.id=t.target_actor_id where t.round_id=p_round and t.state='attesa_difesa' and not combat_panel_private.multiplication_no_defense(t.id) and(x.id=p_actor or x.team_key=v_a.team_key) and (not clan_marionettisti_private.is_dedicated_scene(v_a.session_id) or clan_marionettisti_private.actor_visible(v_a.session_id,x.id,v_uid))),
    'targets',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'team',x.team_key,'state',x.state,'position_m',case when clan_marionettisti_private.is_dedicated_scene(v_a.session_id) then null else x.position_m end)),'[]'::jsonb) from public.combat_v2_actors x where x.session_id=v_a.session_id and x.id<>v_a.id and x.team_key<>v_a.team_key and (x.companion_id is null or x.state='attivo') and (not clan_marionettisti_private.is_dedicated_scene(v_a.session_id) or clan_marionettisti_private.actor_visible(v_a.session_id,x.id,v_uid))),
    'reactions',jsonb_build_array('schivata','parata','nessuna'),'substitution_offers',CASE WHEN v_r.phase='raccolta_difese' THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(so),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.combat_v2_substitution_round_offers_v1(p_round,p_actor)) so
      WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_attack_targets mt
        WHERE mt.round_id=p_round AND mt.attack_declaration_id=(so->>'attack_declaration_id')::uuid
          AND mt.target_actor_id=p_actor AND NOT combat_panel_private.multiplication_no_defense(mt.id))) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) || case when clan_marionettisti_private.is_dedicated_scene(v_a.session_id) then jsonb_build_object('companion_controls',clan_marionettisti_private.relink_options(p_round,p_actor)) else '{}'::jsonb end);
end
